invariants.rationale: The context is likely required to perform engine operations and should not be null before upsert.
A valid instantTime string is usually required to uniquely identify the write instant.
A non-null record list is needed to perform the upsert operation.
Attempting an upsert makes sense if there are records to process; this guards against unnecessary calls with empty or null lists.
If instantTime is provided, it should not be blank or whitespace only.
